description: Remove the override on transfers or accrual lots, so rules and defaults categorize them again.

targetIds.description: Comma-separated transfer ids (the Transfer ID column in exports) or accrual lot ids, up to 500

targetKind.description: transfer for an asset transfer id, accrual_lot for a rebasing accrual's lot id

workspace.description: Workspace alias to run this command in (see `splits auth workspaces`). Overrides SPLITS_WORKSPACE and the active workspace.

name: accounting_categorize_revoke
